projects.title: LUCKY CHARM
projects.description: Privacy-preserving standup and meeting transcript tool: wallet-first auth, TEE-oriented processing, Props-filtered dashboard — structured themes and actions without verbatim quotes leaving the trust boundary.
projects.motivation: Teams need standup signal without leaking raw transcripts: wallet-first auth, filtered views, and TEE-oriented framing so structured themes ship without verbatim quotes crossing the trust line.
projects.highlight: Wallet-first auth and props-filtered views so themes ship without raw transcripts crossing the trust boundary.

projects.title: AUTONOMI
projects.description: Autonomous lending protection on Arc. 24/7 lending bodyguard that auto-rebalances your USYC/USDC position when LTV crosses the safety threshold — no liquidation surprises.
projects.motivation: Hackathon build to keep Arc lending positions inside a safe band automatically so users sleep through volatility instead of babysitting LTV.

projects.title: ARBIT
projects.description: Cryptocurrency arbitrage opportunity dashboard with real-time market data visualization.
projects.motivation: Turn noisy exchange spreads into a readable surface so you can see where edges exist before fees and latency eat them.

projects.title: STITCH
projects.description: Local-first subscription companion: Tauri + React desktop (stitch-app), Python Flask bridge for RAG over your PDFs, Google sign-in + Gmail discovery, and optional face MFA — pairs with the Linkup MCP stack for Cursor.
projects.motivation: Own your subscription data and search it locally: a desktop shell plus a Python bridge so PDFs and Gmail context stay on your machine, with optional stronger auth — not another siloed SaaS dashboard.
projects.highlight: Companion to RanneG/linkup_mcp (LlamaIndex + Ollama) for editor-side RAG.

projects.title: MINESENTRY
projects.description: Bitcoin censorship detection platform - whistle-blowing system for detecting when mining pools exclude transactions from blocks.
projects.motivation: Make pool transaction selection observable so the community can spot censorship or policy shifts instead of guessing from mempool gossip alone.

projects.title: CHATBOT RAG CORE
projects.description: Reusable Python RAG chatbot library using Ollama for local AI. Document Q&A, embeddings, and production-ready API server. On Browse → Projects, a live Groq block demonstrates persona routing (swap system prompts per character) — separate from doc RAG, same integration story.
projects.motivation: A small library you can drop behind an API: ingest docs, embed with Ollama, and answer questions without shipping prompts to a remote model by default.
projects.highlight: Ollama + LlamaIndex — local-first RAG building block.
